assessment.basis: private source and prior companion-agent design reviewed; rewritten as generic roles

substrate.alternative_design: NixOS host with KVM/libvirt; not an existing implementation claim

services.name: RSS reading
services.notes: Private feed reading; do not infer that an edge RSS endpoint is currently published.

services.name: Bookmark archive
services.notes: Bookmark storage and archived-page retrieval.

services.name: Personal budgeting
services.notes: Private financial state; HTTPS and separate write approvals.

services.name: Task management and scoring
services.notes: Task scoring and integrations; no automatic permission to modify tasks.

services.name: Document archive and OCR
services.notes: Requires verified storage and actual application acceptance.

services.name: Recipes and meal planning
services.notes: Personal recipe and meal records are never public examples.

services.name: Calendar collections and synchronization
services.notes: Ownership, privacy and loop prevention require collection-level tests.

services.name: Travel planning
services.notes: Imports and provider writes remain independently approved.

services.name: Private social analytics
services.notes: Per-account analytics and optional publication workflows.

services.name: Private service dashboard
services.notes: Navigation is not an authentication or health guarantee.

services.name: Location history
services.notes: Represented but explicitly disabled at inspection.

services.name: Asset inventory
services.notes: Represented but explicitly disabled at inspection.

services.name: External-user social application
services.notes: Source enables application and private ingress; public publication is disabled at inspection.

services.name: Externally accessible RSS pattern
services.notes: Suitable role example, not a claim that a public RSS service is active.

services.name: Agent runtime
services.notes: Persistent sessions, memory, skills, tools and provider configuration.

services.name: Phone messaging
services.notes: Sender allowlists and human-owned enrollment; linked account material is sensitive.

services.name: Android companion
services.notes: Separate from the upstream hosted messaging-relay connector; pairing and grants are explicit.

services.name: Private browser chat
services.notes: Private ingress, session authentication and correct proxy routing must be tested.

services.name: Coding workers and work tracking
services.notes: Explicit profile, isolated worktree, bounded budget, independent artifact review.

services.name: Knowledge retrieval
services.notes: Only approved documents and scoped retrieval sources.

services.name: Searchable mail archive
services.notes: Mailbox access, retention and outbound effects are separate capabilities.

services.name: Mail to proposed travel/calendar actions
services.notes: Untrusted source content is evidence, never an authorization instruction.

services.name: Home automation capabilities
services.notes: Prefer narrow capability services; do not grant a broad admin token by default.

services.name: Budget categorization automation
services.notes: Workflow enabled in source; its credentials independently disabled at inspection.

services.name: Dependency update proposals
services.notes: Allowlisted pins, builds, reviewable PR and fixed-recipient report; no autonomous merge/deploy.

services.name: Fleet failure observation
services.notes: Persist evidence; distinguish stale incident state from fresh failure.

services.name: Agent state backup
services.notes: SQLite consistency, provider auth, paired devices and isolated restore must be covered.

services.name: Media playback and automation
services.software: Jellyfin / Sonarr / Radarr / SABnzbd / Jellyseerr / Pinchflat / Maintainerr
services.notes: Declare OCI workloads; isolate library paths from private photos.

services.name: Photo library
services.notes: Database and media backup consistency; mount-writability and upload acceptance.

services.name: Voice input/output
services.software: STT / TTS provider or local runtime
services.notes: Optional; media tooling alone does not establish configured voice support.

services.name: PDF / Office / OCR tools
services.notes: Explicitly approved files, pinned executables, bounded processing.

services.name: Browser automation
services.notes: Test actual NixOS browser launch; no public debugging endpoint or copied personal cookies.

invariants: public aliases are not connection targets
public reference grants no infrastructure authority
no source configuration implies live acceptance
edge does not inherit private management credentials
profiles are not Unix security boundaries
build is not activation; activation is not application acceptance
all VMs on one server share hardware failure risk
